#flux: --job-name=120_Iacc
#flux: -t 00:10:00
#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 1
#flux: -q bigmem
#flux: --array=2500-2508

# The following Slurm directive for account was not translated as it is not a standard Flux option.
# It must be filled in by the user or is handled by site-specific policies.
# #SBATCH --account=uoa00424

# CRITICAL: The Slurm memory request '--mem-per-cpu=4096' (4GB) was not translated.
# Flux does not have a standard equivalent directive. The job will receive the default memory allocation,
# which may be insufficient and could cause the job to fail.
# #SBATCH --mem-per-cpu=4096

# The Slurm hint 'nomultithread' is a scheduler-level configuration and cannot be set with a simple Flux directive.
# The request for 1 CPU on a single task implies that the user wants to control thread placement manually.
# Performance may differ if the underlying system has hyperthreading enabled.
# #SBATCH --hint=nomultithread

# The following SLURM directives for email notification were not translated as Flux does not support this functionality directly.
# #SBATCH --mail-type=END
# #SBATCH --mail-user=hjin317@aucklanduni.ac.nz


module load MATLAB/2017b

# 'srun' is not needed for a single-task job; the command is run directly.
# The Slurm array variables are replaced with their Flux equivalents.
# $FLUX_JOB_ID corresponds to $SLURM_ARRAY_JOB_ID, and $FLUX_TASK_ID corresponds to $SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID.
matlab -nodesktop -nosplash -r "EEGlab_120_PreProcessed_v3($FLUX_TASK_ID, '$FLUX_JOB_ID')"

reasons: Validation failed at directive: --array=2500-2508. The job array feature is not part of the core Flux scheduler specification and is often implemented as a site-specific extension; this directive is not universally valid.
issues: CRITICAL: As noted in the script's comments, the original Slurm request for 4GB of memory per CPU (`--mem-per-cpu=4096`) was omitted. The job will receive a default, much smaller memory allocation and is highly likely to fail at runtime due to insufficient memory.

The Slurm hint '--hint=nomultithread' was not translated. If the underlying system has hyperthreading enabled, this could lead to different performance characteristics compared to the original Slurm job, which would have enforced placement on a physical core.

# Flux job script translated from Slurm

#flux: --job-name=120_Iacc

#flux: -n 1

# The following Slurm directive for account was not translated as it is not a standard Flux option.
# It must be filled in by the user or is handled by site-specific policies.

# CRITICAL: The Slurm memory request '--mem-per-cpu=4096' (4GB) was not translated.
# Flux does not have a standard equivalent directive. The job will receive the default memory allocation,

# #SBATCH --mail-type=END
# #SBATCH --mail-user=hjin317@aucklanduni.ac.nz

# CRITICAL: The original Slurm job array (--array=2500-2508) has been converted to a serial for-loop.
# This means each task will run one after another, NOT in parallel.
# The total runtime of this job will be the sum of the runtimes of the individual tasks.

module load MATLAB/2017b

for i in $(seq 2500 2508); do
    echo "--- Starting Serial Task ID: $i ---"
    # $FLUX_JOB_ID is available to identify the parent job.
    matlab -nodesktop -nosplash -r "EEGlab_120_PreProcessed_v3($i, '$FLUX_JOB_ID')"
    echo "--- Finished Serial Task ID: $i ---"
done

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=120_Iacc      # job name (shows up in the queue)
#SBATCH --account=uoa00424     # Project Account
#SBATCH --time=00:10:00         # Walltime (HH:MM:SS)
#SBATCH --mem-per-cpu=4096      # memory/cpu (in MB)
#SBATCH --ntasks=1              # number of tasks (e.g. MPI)
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1       # number of cores per task (e.g. OpenMP)
#SBATCH --partition=bigmem        # specify a partition
#SBATCH --hint=nomultithread    # don't use hyperthreading
#SBATCH --mail-type=END
#SBATCH --mail-user=hjin317@aucklanduni.ac.nz
#SBATCH --array=2500-2508  # Array definition 2101-2121 2200-2219 2301-2320 2401-2430 2501-2508 ([2]Individual(1), acc(2) and participant numbers)
module load MATLAB/2017b
srun matlab -nodesktop -nosplash -r EEGlab_120_PreProcessed_v3 $SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID $SLURM_ARRAY_JOB_ID
